Description: The diagram illustrates the concept of mass number, which is the sum of protons and neutrons in an atom's nucleus. The mass number is represented by the symbol A, and it is equal to the atomic number Z plus the number of neutrons. In this case, the mass number of sodium (Na) is 23, which means that it has 11 protons and 12 neutrons in its nucleus.
